```{webr-r}
set.seed(123)

p <- 0.30
n <- 80

p_hat <- rbinom(n, size = 1, prob = p)
```

```{webr-r}
var(p_hat)
p * (1 - p)
```

```{webr-r}
set.seed(123)

p <- 0.30
n <- 80

p_hat <- replicate(
  10000,
  mean(rbinom(n, size = 1, prob = p))
)
```

```{webr-r}
var(p_hat)

p * (1 - p) / n
```
